themes.title: Far-Right Momentum and Electoral Contestation Ahead of Major Votes
themes.blurb: Right-wing and far-right parties are leveraging strong polling numbers and strategic campaign mobilization ahead of critical elections and coalition negotiations across Europe and the Americas. From Vox's closing pushes in Spain and FrP's surge in Norway to SD's pivotal role in Swedish cabinet formation and AfD's record polling in Germany, right-wing movements are framing themselves as indispensable electoral forces.

countries.name: 🇪🇸 Vox
countries.note: Campaigning vigorously ahead of the Nov 29 vote, holding major rallies and expanding polling weight against PP and PSOE.

countries.name: 🇳🇴 Fremskrittspartiet
countries.note: Surging near 30% in polls while launching aggressive municipal campaigns to expand mayoral seats.

countries.name: 🇸🇪 Sverigedemokraterna
countries.note: Playing a kingmaker role as right-wing coalition negotiations rely on SD support to block left-wing government formation.

countries.name: 🇩🇪 Alternative für Deutschland
countries.note: Rising to second place in North Rhine-Westphalia polling, overtaking traditional establishment parties.

countries.name: 🇦🇷 La Libertad Avanza
countries.note: President Javier Milei formally ratifying his 2027 re-election ambition while organizing national youth congresses.

countries.name: 🇫🇷 Rassemblement National
countries.note: Positioning Marine Le Pen strongly in early 2027 presidential election polling projections and platform debates.

themes.title: Judicial Crackdowns and Surveillance Targeting the Far-Right
themes.blurb: Right-wing leadership and movements across multiple nations are facing intense judicial scrutiny, legal bans, and constitutional battles. From legal proceedings over Bolsonaro's conviction in Brazil and party ban demands against AfD in Germany to constitutional clashes in Poland and eligibility debates surrounding Marine Le Pen in France, right-wing figures portray these actions as politicized weaponization of the judiciary.

countries.name: 🇧🇷 Bolsonarismo / Partido Liberal
countries.note: Supreme Court (STF) moves Bolsonaro's criminal conviction review to full bench amidst ongoing fake news inquiries.

countries.name: 🇩🇪 Alternative für Deutschland
countries.note: Facing public protests and growing political demands for formal state bans (AfD-Verbotsverfahren) and criminal incitement charges.

countries.name: 🇵🇱 Prawo i Sprawiedliwość
countries.note: Locked in a constitutional court crisis with the Tusk government while PiS lawmakers face loss of parliamentary immunity.

countries.name: 🇭🇺 Fidesz / Tisza
countries.note: Fidesz appealing to the Constitutional Court over housing programs while grappling with high-profile corruption probes.

countries.name: 🇫🇷 Rassemblement National
countries.note: Subject to heightened judicial and legal debate regarding Marine Le Pen's eligibility for future presidential runs.

themes.title: National Priority Rhetoric and Hardline Migration Demands
themes.blurb: Hardline rhetoric demanding 'national priority' for native citizens in social benefits, housing, and public safety is converging across European and American right-wing platforms. Parties are framing border control and citizen-first welfare policies as essential protections against social decay and migration pressures.

countries.name: 🇪🇸 Vox
countries.note: Making 'prioridad nacional' the cornerstone of its campaign, demanding native priority for public housing and social aid.

countries.name: 🇫🇷 Rassemblement National
countries.note: Championing worker protections and retirement proposals restricted to French citizens while debating binationality limits.

countries.name: 🇬🇧 Reform UK
countries.note: Pushing strict anti-immigration demands and attacking government proposals perceived as catering to non-native demographics.

countries.name: 🇺🇸 MAGA / Trump
countries.note: Escalating hardline ICE enforcement tactics and border control rhetoric following administrative reviews.

countries.name: 🇩🇪 Alternative für Deutschland
countries.note: Utilizing provocative local campaigns to emphasize national cultural identity and strict border security.

themes.title: Transnational Right-Wing Networking and Parallel Diplomacy
themes.blurb: Right-wing political figures are bypassing standard diplomatic channels to cultivate international alliances, conduct parallel foreign policy, and reinforce cross-border solidarity. High-profile international visits, overseas party operations, and transnational conservative conferences highlight an increasingly interconnected global right.

countries.name: 🇧🇷 Bolsonarismo / Partido Liberal
countries.note: Flávio Bolsonaro operating from Florida to coordinate international opposition strategy while Michelle Bolsonaro travels to Israel.

countries.name: 🇫🇷 Rassemblement National
countries.note: Marine Le Pen holding high-level meetings with foreign diplomats like Ukraine's ambassador to project international credibility.

countries.name: 🇦🇷 La Libertad Avanza
countries.note: Javier Milei leveraging international business relationships and high-tech corporate partnerships like Tesla to project global economic stature.

countries.name: 🇺🇸 MAGA / Trump
countries.note: Serving as an international anchor for global right-wing movements and hosting transnational events like CPAC and TPUSA.

themes.title: Anti-Establishment Hostility to Public Media and Information Control
themes.blurb: Right-wing parties are escalating attacks against state institutions, mainstream media, and digital regulation, accusing establishment governments of censorship and narrative control. Movements frame speech restrictions, voting technology debates, and media coverage as systemic efforts to suppress conservative political voices.

countries.name: 🇧🇷 Bolsonarismo / Partido Liberal
countries.note: Right-wing figures attack proposed legislative restrictions on online speech while Flávio Bolsonaro challenges voting machine integrity from abroad.

countries.name: 🇵🇱 Prawo i Sprawiedliwość
countries.note: Accusing the ruling coalition of biased media manipulation and organizing public protests against state sound and broadcasting controls.

countries.name: 🇭🇺 Fidesz / Tisza
countries.note: Fidesz framing opposition financial leaks as coordinated 'communist ÁVH political theatre' to manipulate public opinion.

countries.name: 🇪🇸 Vox
countries.note: Denouncing campaign sign destruction and media bias, asserting left-wing attempts to intimidate conservative voters.
